description: Kuroha Keiko invited us all along for a trip to the southern paradise Hawaii. I`m very excited as this is my first trip overseas. I can surf the sea and dance Hawaiian dance, this is nothing but the highest enjoyment possible! Hee hee! Mike the instructor looks cute... No no no, I`m just kidding. Sorry Kouichi-kun.

titles.title: Tokonatsu no Shima e Shinro o Tore
常夏の島へ進路をとれ
